title: Pianeta - Worldgen Recrafted
description: Reworks the generation of the overworld - the nether and end will come soon!
body:
Explore a recrafted overworld with this datapack! Climb the tallest mountains, swim the vastest oceans, venture down the colossal caverns! At the moment, Pianeta only updates the Overworld, however it is planned to overhaul the nether and end too, as well as terralith compatibility!

If you find any bugs, please report it to my discord under the Bugs catagory: https://discord.gg/w5dbwC4eKW
